profile.name: FedRAMP Moderate + FDA 21 CFR Part 11 / GxP (commercial)
profile.description: Regulated-research composite: the FedRAMP Moderate baseline plus the FDA 21 CFR Part 11 / GxP overlay in the commercial AWS partition. Add the HIPAA overlay as well when the clinical data includes ePHI (extends: fedramp-moderate, hipaa, fda-21-cfr-part-11). Part 11 electronic-signature and computer-system-validation (CSV) obligations are partly process controls owned by the quality/validation team — see the vertical's open items.
